_comment: Curated human corrections applied on top of machine translation (scripts/apply-i18n-overrides.mjs). 'all' applies to every language (calibration-frame names + core astro jargon kept in English, where MT produced nonsense like Flat->Apartment, Bias->statistical bias). Per-language sections fix homographs MT got wrong as button labels (imperative verb forms, e.g. Resume->résumé). Applied keys are removed from the machine-review markers.

pt-BR.Nothing connected yet. Pick a starting p: Nada conectado ainda. Escolha um ponto de partida abaixo e as demais abas ganham vida assim que seu equipamento estiver online.
pt-BR.Equipment is up. Plan the whole night, r: Equipamento pronto. Planeje a noite inteira, execute uma sequência ou vá direto para o live stacking.

es.Nothing connected yet. Pick a starting p: Nada conectado todavía. Elige un punto de partida abajo y el resto de las pestañas cobran vida cuando tu equipo esté en línea.
es.Equipment is up. Plan the whole night, r: Equipo listo. Planifica toda la noche, ejecuta una secuencia o salta al live stacking.

fr.Nothing connected yet. Pick a starting p: Rien de connecté pour l’instant. Choisissez un point de départ ci-dessous ; les autres onglets s’activent dès que votre équipement est en ligne.
fr.Equipment is up. Plan the whole night, r: Équipement prêt. Planifiez toute la nuit, lancez une séquence ou passez au live stacking.

de.Nothing connected yet. Pick a starting p: Noch nichts verbunden. Wähle unten einen Startpunkt – die übrigen Tabs werden aktiv, sobald deine Ausrüstung online ist.
de.Equipment is up. Plan the whole night, r: Ausrüstung bereit. Plane die ganze Nacht, starte eine Sequenz oder springe ins Live-Stacking.
